Watch Chandragupta Maurya Episode - 86 now!
Synopsis :
Daimaa regains her consciousness and reveals to Shipra about Chandragupta's true identity. Shipra rushes towards Dhaananad, but Indrajalik captures her. Sthoolbhadra diverts Dhananand's attention and gets permission from him to join Durdhara for Hawa Mahal. Durdhara fails to get moved by Chandragupta and waits for Shipra's return. Elsewhere, Vajrabahu prepares his soldiers for the upcoming battle against the Magadha kingdom. Chanakya meets Vajrabahu in the Assaka kingdom and gifts him his favorite fruits.
